senses.en_definition: A clock or watch; an instrument for showing or measuring time.
An hour; a unit of time equal to sixty minutes.
The time of day, expressed in hours.
A particular time or period, including one allocated to work or lessons.

messages.en: What time will you get here? I've been waiting for almost an hour.
I'll be there in ten minutes. Traffic's really bad. Sorry, mate.
I'm outside the mall now. Which way do I go to get to the station?
Just take that footbridge. The station's on your right when you come down.

senses.en_definition: Do not; used to tell or advise someone not to do something.

messages.en: Don't forget to come tonight, okay? We've booked a table for eight o'clock.
I'm finishing work a bit late today. I'm worried I won't make it by eight.
Don't worry, we'll wait for you. Just text us when you get here.
Don't worry, I'm already at the station.
Okay, just wait by the main entrance. I'm coming to pick you up now.
